title: {{APP_TITLE}}: weekly risk digest
description: SCAFFOLD. Every Monday, summarises open and newly resolved recommendations (from the lifecycle workflow) so owners see risks that are not urgent enough to page anyone. Not deployed by default.

open_items.name: open_items
open_items.description: Latest state of every tracked recommendation

input.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-30d
| filter event.type=="easytrade.insights.recommendation" and namespace=="{{NAMESPACE}}"
| sort timestamp desc
| summarize status=takeFirst(status), summary=takeFirst(summary), by:{container, rule}
| sort status asc

notify.name: notify
notify.description: TODO: set recipients. Disabled in the scaffold.

input.subject: [{{NAMESPACE}}] Weekly observability and risk digest
input.content:
{% for r in result("open_items").records %}{{ r.status }}: {{ r.container }} - {{ r.summary }}
{% endfor %}
